BiblicalUsage: Sered was the first son of Zebulun, named among the sons who went down to Egypt with Jacob. His family, the Sardites, was still counted in the wilderness census a generation later.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the family lines straight, and a name in a list is a person He has not forgotten.
